To,         Date: September 03, 2026 
BSE Limited 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Dalal

Scrip Code: 523732 
 
Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Intimation of Receipt of 
order/contract. 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that Ecoboard Industries 
Limited (“the Company”) has secured an order in normal course of business from 
Sri Balaji Bio Energies and Organics Private Limited, For Design, Procurement, 
Manufacturing, Supply, Erection & Commissioning Of 12 TPD Compressed Biogas 
(CBG) Plant having an order value of INR 20,50,00,000 (Rupees Twenty Crores and 
Fifty Lakhs). 
 
The disclosure, as required under Schedule III of the SEBI LODR Regulations read with 
SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 
30, 2026 is enclosed as Annexure – A to this letter. 
 
Kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For, Ecoboard Industries Limited 
 
 
Praveen Kumar Raju Gottumukkala 
Whole Time Director and CFO 
DIN: 05180152 
 
Encl.: Annexure A
